# Pipeline


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A
[`Report`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#report)
takes an evaluation through four stages:

1.  Download. `download` fetches the evaluation’s documents from the IOM
    repository.
2.  OCR. `ocr` converts the report PDF to Markdown pages, with fixed
    heading levels.
3.  Curation. A person selects the report’s core sections in the curator
    app (`06_curator.ipynb`).
4.  Mapping. The `map_*` methods score the core sections against the
    themes of the [Strategic Results Framework
    (SRF)](https://srf.iom.int) and the [Global Compact for Migration
    (GCM)](https://docs.un.org/en/A/RES/73/195).

[`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
runs the stages for one evaluation, and
[`batch_run`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#batch_run)
for many.

``` python
from cachy import enable_cachy
enable_cachy()
```

## Report class

A
[`Report`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#report)
wraps an
[`Evaluation`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/readers.html#evaluation),
with the state of each stage: `pdf_path`, `md_path`, `curation_status`,
`selected_headings` and `mappings`. Creating a
[`Report`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#report)
loads the saved state from `results_path`, when there is one.

#### Creating reports

Create a report from the URL of its PDF:

``` python
evals = load_evals('files/test/evaluations.json')

url = "https://evaluation.iom.int/sites/g/files/tmzbdl151/files/docs/resources/AAP%20Evaluation%20Report_final_.pdf"
report = Report.from_url(url, evals, results_path='files/test/results')

```

## Persistence

`save` writes a report’s state to `results_path/<id>.json`. The file
holds the evaluation, the report URL, the curation status, the selected
headings, the mappings and a timestamp. `ocr`, each `map_*` method and
[`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
save the report after they run. `download` does not.
[`load_report`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#load_report)
reads the state back from a base folder, which holds the `pdf/`, `md/`
and `results/` folders. It sets `pdf_path` and `md_path` to the report’s
folders under `pdf/` and `md/`, when they exist.

## Pipeline methods

Run the methods in stage order. `download` comes first, then `ocr`, then
the `map_*` methods once the report is curated.

### Download

`download` saves every document of the evaluation in `dst/<id>/` with
[`download_eval`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/downloaders.html#download_eval),
and sets `pdf_path` to that folder. It does nothing when `pdf_path` is
already set, unless `force` is true.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/franckalbinet/iomeval/blob/main/iomeval/pipeline.py#L172"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### Report.download

``` python
def download(
    dst:str='data/pdf', # Folder to create the report's folder in
    force:bool=False, # Download again when `pdf_path` is set
)->__main__.Report: # The report, for chaining
```

*Download the evaluation’s documents to `dst/<id>/`*

``` python
url = "https://evaluation.iom.int/sites/g/files/tmzbdl151/files/docs/resources/Abridged%20Evaluation%20Report_%20Final_Olta%20NDOJA.pdf"
report = Report.from_url(url, evals, results_path='files/test/results')
_ = report.download(dst='files/test/pdf')
```

### OCR

`ocr` converts the report PDF to Markdown pages in `dst/<id>/` with
mistocr’s `pdf_to_md`. mistocr OCRs the PDF with Mistral and fixes the
heading levels with an LLM. With `add_img_desc`, it also adds a
description of each image. The PDF is the file named after `pdf_url` in
`pdf_path`, or the first PDF there when `pdf_url` is not set. `ocr` does
nothing when `dst/<id>/` exists, unless `force` is true.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/franckalbinet/iomeval/blob/main/iomeval/pipeline.py#L183"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### Report.ocr

``` python
async def ocr(
    dst:str='data/md', # Folder to create the report's Markdown folder in
    add_img_desc:bool=True, # Add a description of each image, written by an LLM
    force:bool=False, # OCR again when `dst/<id>/` exists
    progress:bool=False, # Log mistocr's progress
    fix_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `fix_hdgs`
    desc_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `add_img_descs`
)->__main__.Report: # The report, for chaining
```

*OCR the report PDF into Markdown pages in `dst/<id>/`, and save the
report*

``` python
await report.ocr(dst='files/test/md', add_img_desc=False, force=False)
```

### Curate

A person reviews the OCR’d headings and selects the core sections in the
curator app (`06_curator.ipynb`). The app then sets `curation_status` to
`'sections_selected'` and saves the headings in `selected_headings`.

#### Extracting sections

`get_sections` extracts the selected sections of a curated report. It
raises `ValueError` when the report is not OCR’d, is not curated, or has
no selected headings. For the curated test report:

``` python
report = load_report('49d2fba781b6a7c0d94577479636ee6f', base_path='files/test')
report.selected_headings
```

## Thematic mapping

Each `map_*` method maps the selected sections against one theme set,
and saves the report. You can run each one on its own after curation. A
method skips a theme set that is already in `mappings`, unless `force`
is true. `ensure_sp` builds the report system prompt from the selected
sections once, and the later mappings reuse it.

<a
href="https://github.com/franckalbinet/iomeval/blob/main/iomeval/pipeline.py#L212"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>


report already has one*

### map_single

``` python
async def map_single(
    sp, # Report system prompt from `mk_system_prompt`
    theme_type, # `'enbs'`, `'ccps'`, `'gcms'` or `'outs'`
    path:NoneType=None, # Folder of theme files; `None` uses the files shipped with the package
    model:str='claude-haiku-4-5', # LLM to use
    gcm_ids:NoneType=None, # GCM objective IDs whose linked outputs to map, for `'outs'`
    *,
    response_format:pydantic._internal._model_construction.ModelMetaclass=ThemeScores, # Pydantic model the reply must follow
    temperature:float=0, # Sampling temperature
    reasoning_effort:str=None, # `'low'`, `'medium'` or `'high'`; `None` for no extended thinking
)->list[dict]: # Score dicts from `parse_res`
```

*Map the report in `sp` against one theme set, with its prompt and
formatting*

``` python
async def map_gcms(

)->__main__.Report: # The report, for chaining
```

*Map the selected sections against the GCM objectives, and save the
report*

``` python
await report.map_gcms(model='claude-haiku-4-5', force=False)
```

### Map outputs

`map_outs` maps the SRF outputs linked to `gcm_ids`. By default, it uses
the top GCM objective from `map_gcms`. When no GCM objective reaches the
[`get_top_ids`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#get_top_ids)
threshold, it maps nothing and leaves `outs` out of `mappings`.

## Run the full pipeline

[`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
takes one evaluation, found by `url`, `id` or `title`, as far through
the stages as it can. It first loads the report’s saved state from
`base_path`, and it skips the stages already done. It returns a
[`PipelineResult`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#pipelineresult)
with one of three statuses:

- `'awaiting_curation'` when the report still needs curation. Curate it
  in the curator app, then run the same call again.
- `'completed'` after the four mappings.
- `'failed'` when a stage raises an error.
  [`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
  logs the error, and the result holds its message in `error` and the
  stage in `step`.

Errors raised while creating the report, such as a missing report URL,
are not caught. `force` runs stages again. Pass `True` for every stage,
or a set of step names such as `{'ocr', 'gcms'}`. The step names are
`'download'`, `'ocr'`, `'enbs'`, `'ccps'`, `'gcms'` and `'outs'`. By
default,
[`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
deletes the PDF folder after OCR.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/franckalbinet/iomeval/blob/main/iomeval/pipeline.py#L302"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

``` python
def should_force(
    force, # `True` or `False` for every step, or a set of step names
    step, # Step name, such as `'ocr'`
)->bool: # Whether to run `step` again
```

*Check whether `force` applies to `step`*

``` python
    step:NoneType=None, # Stage the run stopped at, when it did not complete
):
```

``` python
async def run_pipeline(
    evals:list, # Evaluations to search
    url:str=None, # URL of the report PDF
    id:str=None, # Evaluation ID
    title:str=None, # Evaluation title
    base_path:str='data', # Folder holding `pdf/`, `md/` and `results/`

    fix_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `fix_hdgs`
    desc_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `add_img_descs`
    force:bool | set=False, # `True` to run every step again, or a set of step names
    delete_pdf:bool=True, # Delete the PDF folder after OCR
    verbose:bool=False, # Log each step
    **kwargs
)->__main__.PipelineResult: # The report and how far the run got
```

## Batch

The IOM repository export, from
[evaluation-search-pdf](https://evaluation.iom.int/evaluation-search-pdf),
lists each evaluation’s documents with their type, such as brief, annex
or final report. The types and URLs do not always match. A URL labelled
“Evaluation Report” can point to an annex or a brief. IOM knows about
this bug and is fixing it.

As a workaround,
[`IOMRepoReader.to_json`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/readers.html#iomreporeader.to_json)
gets each evaluation’s report URL from IOM’s UNEG API,
`/json/api/evaluation-uneg`. It adds that URL as the evaluation’s first
document, with subtype `'Evaluation report (UNEG)'`, and
[`eval_url`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/readers.html#eval_url)
prefers it. The UNEG API has less metadata than the export.

``` python
evals[0].docs
```

[`batch_run`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#batch_run)
runs
[`run_pipeline`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#run_pipeline)
on each evaluation in `evals`, after
[`filter_evals`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#filter_evals).
It skips the reports that have all four mappings, unless `force` is set.
It counts an evaluation without a report URL as failed, at step
`'url_lookup'`. At the end, it saves the
[`BatchResult`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#batchresult)
to `base_path/batch_runs/<timestamp>.json`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/franckalbinet/iomeval/blob/main/iomeval/pipeline.py#L436"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### batch_run

``` python
async def batch_run(
    evals, # Evaluations to run
    base_path:str='../../data', # Folder holding `pdf/`, `md/` and `results/`
    year:str=None, # Keep the evaluations of this year, such as `'2023'`
    ids:list=None, # Keep the evaluations with these IDs; takes precedence over `year`
    force:bool | set=False, # `True` to run every step again, or a set of step names
    stop_after:int=None, # Stop after N reports; not implemented yet
    delete_pdf:bool=False, # Delete each report's PDF folder after OCR
    add_img_desc:bool=True, # Add image descriptions during OCR
    fix_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `fix_hdgs`
    desc_kwargs:dict=None, # Passed to mistocr's `add_img_descs`
    **kwargs
)->__main__.BatchResult: # IDs of the evaluations, grouped by outcome
```

*Run the pipeline on each evaluation, and save a summary of the run*

``` python

```

``` python
                         add_img_desc=False, verbose=False, model='claude-haiku-4-5')
```
